title: Discover blocked Universaarl setup number-series fields
purpose: Find the safe UI/technical field routes for the blocked setup assignments before any master data, document, preview or posting work.
entryCriteria: TARGET-017 result exists and shows 4/7 setup field assignments observed or already assigned.
Blocked fields are Customer Nos., Purchase Order Nos. and Item Nos.
No master data or document creation has started.
exitCriteria: For each blocked field, page/field diagnostics identify the field as visible, hidden, unavailable or ambiguous.
If a field can be mapped safely, the next case may assign it with before/after/reopen proof.
If a field is unavailable, document the exact FastTab/Personalize/Page Inspection evidence and choose the next foundation dependency consciously.
stopIf: BC shows any instance other than playthru.
BC shows any active company other than UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A dialog requests creation, deletion, posting, preview or unrelated setup confirmation.
The UI route would repeat TARGET-017 blind field typing without new field diagnostics.
Personalize mode would save changes instead of only inspecting available fields.

lookahead.reason: Blocked assignment fields need UI diagnostics before setup can be considered complete.
Master data waits for posting groups, VAT and dimensions after numbering.
VAT setup follows posting group preflight before any document preview.
Dimensions should be available before rich process evidence.
Customers, vendors and items should use final setup mappings.

nextStep: Diagnose Customer Nos., Purchase Order Nos. and Item Nos. with field/page/screenshot QA before continuing to master data or posting groups.
